Check the raw FID baseline

dot-check_fid_baseline.Rd

Check the raw FID baseline

Usage

.check_fid_baseline(fid, tol_snr = 5)

Arguments

fid

List with numeric rt and intensity (at least 20 points), as in a gcms_fid_exp$fid.

tol_snr

Tolerance, in multiples of the noise level, for the baseline offset at the start of the run and for departures from a straight line.

Value

Invisibly, a list with ok, offset (fitted baseline at the first point), slope (per minute), curvature (largest departure of the baseline from the fitted line) and noise.

Details

The baseline is estimated in ten equal blocks as the 10th percentile (corrected for noise), which peaks barely affect, then fitted with a line. Polyarc quantification assumes a baseline near zero or a straight drift. A curved baseline warns with class moosaic-warning-fid_baseline_curved; an offset beyond tolerance warns with class moosaic-warning-fid_baseline_offset. The intensities are never modified.
